- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot upward momentum.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative or neutral; model reacts too slowly to bearish signals.
- Lag in price correction: model often delays downward adjustments after recent highs.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects downward after strong upward moves, then undercorrects upward after strong drops.
- Sentiment-driven bias: when sentiment is positive (≥0.3), model tends to overreact; when negative (≤-0.2), model underreacts.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are overly optimistic in early cycles; later cycles show better alignment with true price paths.
- Avoid averaging sentiment across all days; weight recent sentiment (last 5–7 days) more heavily for correction.
